# COOL SITES OF THE WEEK [italic]Picked by the Yotta! team, who spend all shift on the ExtraNet so you do not have to. Our supervisor would like that last part removed.[/italic]
[color=#D01070][bold]SITE OF THE WEEK[/bold][/color]
## SPACEGPT [netlink="spacegpt.ai" link="spacegpt.ai"] You type a question. It answers. Sometimes it answers a different question, a better one. Our team asked it which site should be Site of the Week. It said lock your door. We have given it Site of the Week out of caution.
## ALSO COOL - [netlink="ColonyPedia" link="colonypedia.ref"] Look up anything. The talk pages are where the real fighting is. - [netlink="YouTape" link="youtape.vhs"] Watch a man eat a ration bar for forty minutes. We did. All of it. - [netlink="The Hydrogen Line" link="hydrogenline.fm"] A radio station named after the noise the universe makes. The DJ is better. - [netlink="OreMatch" link="orematch.love"] Our Working Joe signed up. It has had three matches. We have had none. We are reviewing our profiles. - [netlink="VectorQuest" link="vectorquest.nav"] Directions from your bunk to the canteen in only nine minutes of loading.
## NOT COOL - Typing in addresses you found scratched on the inside of a locker. You do not know where those go. Neither do we. Stay on the directory.
